units.source_text: 歌声一停，这回是淘米的声音。

en.t: When the singing stopped, this time it was the sound of rice being washed.

units.source_text: 男人轻轻地叹了一口气，翻了个身，期盼似的浑身紧绷等待着……

en.t: The man sighed softly, turned over, and waited with his whole body tense, as if in anticipation...

units.source_text: 再过一会儿，女人会端着盛了水的脸盆来给我擦身吧。

en.t: In a little while, the woman would probably come with a basin of water to wipe my body.

units.source_text: 沙子和汗水浸泡的皮肤，已经到了快发炎的地步了。

en.t: His skin, soaked with sand and sweat, had already reached the point where it was about to become inflamed.

units.source_text: 只要一想到冰凉的、濡湿的毛巾，他就禁不住要打寒战。

en.t: Just thinking of the cold, damp towel made him unable to keep from shivering.
